questions.prompt: What is the capital city of Nigeria?

hints.nudge: It starts with the letter A and has 5 letters.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Nigeria article.

questions.proof: The capital city is Abuja, while its economic center and most populated city is Lagos.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries shares a border with Nigeria?

hints.nudge: It starts with the letter B and has 5 letters.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Nigeria article.

questions.proof: Nigeria shares its borders with Niger to the north, Benin to the west, Cameroon to the east, and Chad to the northeast.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “There is also a conflict with a neighboring country; The Bakassi conflict involves _____ and Nigeria.”

questions.proof: There is also a conflict with a neighboring country; The Bakassi conflict involves Cameroon and Nigeria.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “The war which took place between 6 July _____ and 15 January 1970, was a political conflict caused by the attempted secession of the southeastern provinces of Nigeria as the self-proclaimed Republic of Biafra.”

questions.proof: The war which took place between 6 July 1967 and 15 January 1970, was a political conflict caused by the attempted secession of the southeastern provinces of Nigeria as the self-proclaimed Republic of Biafra.
